title: Library Visits Fell To 800 Million While Digital Borrowing Rose
hook: Library visits fell to 800 million, but borrowing moved online.
closing: Your library did not disappear; much of it moved onto the phone already in your hand.
question: Do you borrow library books digitally?

segments.say: Physical library visits reached 800 million in 2023. Buildings stayed quieter even after the sharp collapse.
Digital library checkouts reached 739 million in 2024. Borrowers changed the doorway, not the habit.
